title: Your private van stash
summary: Store up to 24 items in the rear of the operations van, saved across restarts.
notes: Open a rear cargo door while the van is lowered to access storage private to your player.
Store and take items with large tap buttons, phone-sized item grids and a Back button that stays visible.
Signed-in storage saves with your account inventory; offline play uses a local save. Transfers save carried and stored items together.
